_doc: Time of day (render/daylight.gd, Roadcraft render/scene.ts): hours, sun/moon arc in degrees, light colours (sRGB) and Godot energies (three intensity / pi); moon_energy and hemi_night_k: a screen is not an eye adapted to the night, so the levels are not the 0.05-0.3 lx of the full moon against 100 000 lx of the sun (Kyba, Mohar & Posch 2017, Astronomy & Geophysics) but what the median wall shows in the 4.0 at 22:00, 0.019 of linear Rec. 709 luminance against our 0.004 (ports/build/evidence/look), brought to radiance through the inverse of ACES; the moon stays well over the sky's 2 mlx as it does outdoors, sky gradient, fog, shadows, tone mapping.
